name: Helicopter
description: Helicopter-like detection for BBC NHU0509724 playback using relative background level qualification and device-bench spectral/band centers. Not aircraft model identification.
reference: BBC helicopter recording bbc_helicopter_nhu0509724.mp3 + EAR office Sonos captures
target: Detect a helicopter-like acoustic event above measured background

source.format_ae: WAV mono PCM s16le 16 kHz (ffmpeg; no gain/AGC)

firmware_match.calibration: Means over elevated device-bench windows (rms >= bg+4 dB, flatness <= 0.35) across six captures at Sonos 0.25/0.45/0.65 on EAR-001 and EAR-002

device_bench.note: Live as001_matched were all zero under absolute rms_min=-22 + synthetic spectral gates; offline replay of relative-bg AS-001 detects on all six runs
